source.queue_precondition: all candidates queued with attempt_count 0 at selection time

selection_configuration.method: Deterministic next cohort from the unchanged powered-holdout selector after excluding the first Session 12 cohort and every venue ID in the original benchmark lineage; 25 untouched queued venues per region, alternating known/missing source-website targets, with unchanged balancing rules.
selection_configuration.partition_rule: all selected venues remain locked until capture and independent adjudication are complete

power_preregistration.basis: Combined planning rule fixed before any search on the extension selection
power_preregistration.caveat: The fixed pooled threshold is an acceptance criterion; no result-dependent extension or exclusion is allowed.

evaluation_preregistration.policy: publish only a candidate domain with independently verified venue ownership
evaluation_preregistration.tuning_policy: no policy or evaluator changes after the extension freeze; evaluate the two separately fingerprinted cohorts exactly once after complete capture and adjudication
evaluation_preregistration.pooled_scope: all conclusive publications across both fixed 500-venue cohorts
evaluation_preregistration.acceptance: at least 73 conclusive publications, zero false publications, and official-site precision Wilson lower bound >= 0.95
evaluation_preregistration.resource_role_metrics: not evaluated by minimal URL/title fixtures
